question: If 1 is added to each odd digit and 1 is subtracted from each even digit in the number 58132745, what will be the sum of the digits which are second from the left and third from the right?
solution:
Given: 58132745

If 1 is added to each odd digit and 1 is subtracted from each even digit:

 
• 5 (odd) + 1 = 6
 
• 8 (even) - 1 = 7
 
• 1 (odd) + 1 = 2
 
• 3 (odd) + 1 = 4
 
• 2 (even) - 1 = 1
 
• 7 (odd) + 1 = 8
 
• 4 (even) - 1 = 3
 
• 5 (odd) + 1 = 6

The new number is 67241836.

The digit which is second from the left: 7

The digit which is third from the right: 8

So, the sum of the digits which are second from the left and third from the right is:

→ 7 + 8 = 15.

The correct answer is "Option 1".
